notes.title: Gunpowder Cocktail v0.7.3. A big update.
notes.content:
Hey, I'm here after a long time (sorry), but I have some good news for you.



Brace yourselves... I just bring a big update…



Update Content/Changelog:



1750 New Renders.

18 New Animations.

Interactive Phone System

6 New Phone App

->Whutsapp: A messaging app.

->InstaCram: A photo sharing app. Characters will post here from time to time.

->Campus Hub: You will be able to see characters'(MC&Hazel) in-school grades in this app.            

->Wallpaper App: You can change your phones wallpaper with this.

->Gallery App: Now you will be able to see both galleries with this shortcut.

->Snake Game: I don't now why I make this...

2 New Minigames

->Coin Miner on MC's PC and Interactive School Exams.

A Lot of New Locations. All of them active and accessible. Additionally, some locations now feature different population variations depending on the day and time.

Here are the Locations:

College

-> College Entry, College Hall(Main, Right and Left), Class, Restrooms, Staff Room, Lab, Library, Gymnasium, Second Floor, Principals Room.

City Center

-> Movie Theater, Spa, Tech Store, Subway.

Spa

-> Reception, Spa Room, Sauna.

Photo Studio

Home Basement



Hint System is completely reworked. Now everything is more legible.

The gallery is reworked and fully updated. It has now been split into two parts and both the in-story scenes and special renders can be found here. You can also access the gallery via phone.

You now receive a notification message when the update content ends.



Yeah, I think that's all. Dive in and tell me what you think!



Peace!

notes.title: New Update, New Content!
notes.content:
-Steam Update v0.1-

Update Content:

-Added a new Halloween themed bonus NTR story (200 new renders and 2 new animations).
*In order to play this story you need to finish the existing content in the main story. Then after that, an exe file will appear on the MC's computer. Run it.

-Hazel and Selina's panties added. You can find them while wandering in Free Roam.

-Added new bathroom fantasy scenes (8 new renders).

-Added 1 new lust mode frame.

-Added 1 new Hidden Card.

-Achievements are now functional and working (currently there are 4 achievements but new ones will be added).
*Note: You may need to replay the game to earn some of the Achievements( just for one of them, I think ).

I hope you enjoy this update and make your day better!


And...I would like to give a brief explanation about the future content for those who wonder.

Yes, this game is not labeled as early access, but it will receive regular updates at regular intervals and you will be able to play new content for free. So, yes, the game won't just stay with its current content, New ones will be added.

Thanks!
